title: CSV：方言探测与 DictReader/DictWriter
expected_output:
探测分隔符 = '|'
探测引号符 = '"'
是否含表头 = True

   {'id': '1', 'name': 'tom', 'city': 'bj'}
   {'id': '2', 'name': 'amy', 'city': 'sh'}

DictWriter 产出（city 不在 fieldnames，被 ignore 丢弃）:
'id,name\r\n3,jo\r\n'

若 extrasaction 用默认值 raise，这里会抛 ValueError —— 线上常因多一列直接崩
code:
import csv
import io

sample = "id|name|city\n1|tom|bj\n2|amy|sh\n"

dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=",;|\t")
print("探测分隔符 =", repr(dialect.delimiter))
print("探测引号符 =", repr(dialect.quotechar))
print("是否含表头 =", csv.Sniffer().has_header(sample))
print()

rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(sample), dialect=dialect))
for r in rows:
    print("  ", dict(r))
print()

out = io.StringIO()
writer = csv.DictWriter(out, fieldnames=["id", "name"], extrasaction="ignore")
writer.writeheader()
writer.writerow({"id": "3", "name": "jo", "city": "gz"})
print("DictWriter 产出（city 不在 fieldnames，被 ignore 丢弃）:")
print(repr(out.getvalue()))
print()
print("若 extrasaction 用默认值 raise，这里会抛 ValueError —— 线上常因多一列直接崩")
